beamngEarth_devToggle.title: BeamNG.Earth: toggle dev overlays
beamngEarth_devToggle.desc: Turns the last-used BeamNG.Earth dev tools preset on (default: LOD), or everything off. Unbound by default.

beamngEarth_wireframe.title: BeamNG.Earth: wireframe view
beamngEarth_wireframe.desc: Shows the world as triangle edges (how the ground, the far terrain and the roads are built), or turns it off again (Ctrl+Alt+W).

beamngEarth_reportNote.title: BeamNG.Earth: report an issue / idea
beamngEarth_reportNote.desc: Captures a screenshot, the location, the performance and your hardware now, and opens a window to describe a map issue, performance issue, bug or idea; saves a ready-to-post GitHub issue (Ctrl+Shift+E).

beamngEarth_reportBench.title: BeamNG.Earth: performance profiler (30 s)
beamngEarth_reportBench.desc: Records 30 s of frame times while you drive, then opens the report window for a performance issue (Ctrl+Shift+Y).

beamngEarth_theDrive.title: BeamNG.Earth: The Drive (through downtown)
beamngEarth_theDrive.desc: Frederick to Castle Rock through Denver Union Station: puts the car in Frederick, sets the GPS and the time of day (BeamNG.Earth settings), and times the run from when you move (Ctrl+Alt+D).

beamngEarth_theDriveI25.title: BeamNG.Earth: The Drive (straight down I-25)
beamngEarth_theDriveI25.desc: Frederick to Castle Rock straight down I-25 (no toll roads): puts the car in Frederick, sets the GPS and the time of day, and times the run (Ctrl+Alt+I).

beamngEarth_autodriveToggle.onDown: local d = require('beamngEarth/thedrive') if d then d.toggleAutodrive() end
beamngEarth_autodriveToggle.title: BeamNG.Earth: GPS autodrive on / off
beamngEarth_autodriveToggle.desc: The car drives itself along the GPS route (The Drive or a place picked on the map), or gives you the wheel back (Ctrl+Alt+A).

beamngEarth_goldenHour.onDown: local d = require('beamngEarth/thedrive') if d then d.skyNow('golden') end
beamngEarth_goldenHour.title: BeamNG.Earth: golden hour now
beamngEarth_goldenHour.desc: Sets the clock to 45 minutes before today's sunset where you are (the sky switches to Manual; Real time in the settings goes back) (Ctrl+Alt+G).

beamngEarth_nightNow.onDown: local d = require('beamngEarth/thedrive') if d then d.skyNow('night') end
beamngEarth_nightNow.title: BeamNG.Earth: night now
beamngEarth_nightNow.desc: Sets the clock to 21:30 where you are (the sky switches to Manual; Real time in the settings goes back) (Ctrl+Alt+N).

beamngEarth_mapToggle.title: BeamNG.Earth: world map
beamngEarth_mapToggle.desc: Opens the BeamNG.Earth world map (where you are, saved places, click to teleport), or closes it. In our level the game's map key (M) and the pause menu's Map open it; unbound by default (bind a key here if you like).
